service.description: The jobs of the working tree's ci.xml (or why there are none: no file, an error with its line): each pipeline, job, image, its matrix combinations (matrixKeys, and combinations: each with its steps, variables, the script it runs whole and that script's digest), and the secrets it asks for, which a local run does not have; each combination with imageScript and imageDigest too, the script a run in the image runs. container: whether Docker or Podman answers here (available, engine, socket, note).

Run one job (pipeline, job, matrixKey: one combination of a matrix job, the first by default) of the working tree's ci.xml in a new host session of the Terminal, in the working tree: its steps in order as the job runs them (sh -c each, stopping at one that fails unless continue-on-error), with its variables and CI's own, and its secrets' variables unset, only when the script is the one get#LocalJobs showed (its digest). The script is the server user's alone (0600 in a 0700 directory) and removes itself when it ends; it is typed into the server user's shell. Not the job's image. From a session only. With where image: the same steps in a container of the job's image (its image pulled when the engine does not have it), kept in as a CI job's container is (no privilege or capability, a read-only root, an init, a user that is not root, the dev-aide conf's local-run-memory-mb and local-run-pids), on a copy of the working tree's files (no .git, links as links, at most local-run-copy-mb) mounted at the working directory and deleted when the run ends: nothing comes back to the tree; no network on a shared dev server. It needs TERMINAL_HOST, a root the tier may write that does not hold the runtime, and fewer than local-run-limit runs of the user's going; one past local-run-timeout-minutes is stopped. The user's earlier ended runs are removed. Out runId, which get#LocalRun follows.

parameter.name: where
parameter.description: host (a terminal) or image (a container of the job's image)

parameter.name: digest
parameter.description: The digest of the script get#LocalJobs showed: a script rebuilt to something else (ci.xml changed since) is refused

service.description: A run in the job's image (runId) of the current user's: state (starting while its image is pulled and its container made, running, exited, failed with error, or missing), exitCode once it ended, and log, its last 2000 lines, timedOut when it was stopped past its time. Another user's run, or another server's container, is refused.
A run in the job's image of the current user's removed, running or not; one still being made is stopped and removed once it is.

./moq build of the package this server runs (--debug for target/debug/moqui, and so on), typed into a new host session of the Terminal in the checkout as exec ./moq build, so the session ends with the build's exit status. The full tier's, audited (DAA_BUILD, with the Terminal's refusal when it opened nothing); only on Unix (the Terminal's host sessions) where the runtime has moq beside it; from a session only. Restart (org.moqui.dev.DevToolsServices.restart#Server) runs the new binary once the session ended with 0.

Whether this runtime can rebuild (available: Unix, it has moq, and the user the full tier), and a rebuild's session (sessionId, else the user's last): state running, succeeded (ended with 0), failed or gone (no longer listed), and its exitStatus.
